title: Fire Emblem

widgets.text: Units in roster order (deploy order). Weapon ranks: E 1, D 31, C 71, B 121, A 181, S 251 points.

Weapon triangle: swords beat axes, axes beat lances, lances beat swords (+hit/+dmg). Anima beats light, light beats dark, dark beats anima. Bows deal triple-like damage to fliers; armour-slaying, horse-slaying and reaver weapons flip the matchups.
widgets.title: Tips

widgets.text: Each unit carries 5 items; extras go to the convoy (Merlinus / the supply wagon). Vulneraries heal 10 HP, Elixirs full; Door/Chest keys or a Thief open locks. Stat boosters: Angelic Robe (HP), Energy Ring (Str), Secret Book (Skl), Speedwing (Spd), Goddess Icon (Lck), Dracoshield (Def), Talisman (Res), Body Ring (Con).
Recruit by talking: Sain/Kent (Lyn), Erk, Matthew, Bartre, Dorcas, Guy (talk with Lyn in her tale), Legault, Raven (Priscilla), Jaffar (Nino), Karel, Harken, Pent (Louise).

Lyn's tale (prologue + 10 chapters) is the tutorial; then Eliwood's or Hector's tale (Hector = harder, a few extra chapters). Gaiden chapters ('x') unlock by meeting conditions, e.g. finishing a chapter within a turn limit or keeping a unit alive.

notes: Unit structs 72 bytes from 0x0202BD50 (RA); enemy structs assumed at +0x1170 (0x0202CEC0), the usual GBA FE layout. gbaverify 2026-10-25, prologue turn 1: unit 1 = Lyn LV1 HP 16/16 Str 4 Skl 7 Spd 9 Def 2 Res 0 Lck 5, Iron Sword (id 1) 46 uses; enemy list shows the 2 prologue enemies (LV2 21 HP, LV1 20 HP); route 1 = Lyn. Rows have no names (no name table in RAM): '#' = roster slot.
